snippet.title: Super Chipflake Ü - Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
A strange adventure awaits you! Explore Schländ - a big, weird world with many pretty weird people with even weirder problems! Find all the ingredients to make the best schnitzel ever in this fun collectathon for PC and Nintendo Switch.

Wishlist now!

On Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3064060/Super_Chipflake__Quest_for_the_Uncooked_Schnitzel/
EU Nintendo eShop: Coming Soon
American Nintendo eShop: http://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/super-chipflake-u-quest-for-the-uncooked-schnitzel-switch

Song by @JiggyTones 
Out now on streaming services:
https://distrokid.com/hyperfollow/jiggytones/super-chipflake--with-lyrics-feat-ben-zimmermann--jayhan-2

#indiegame #chipflake #gamedev
